meta.name: VoltGuard Safety Playbook
references: NFPA 70E-2024 Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace
NFPA 70E Annex D - Incident Energy and Arc Flash Boundary Calculation Methods
OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 - Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution
OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 - Control of Hazardous Energy (Lockout/Tagout)
ASTM D120 - Standard Specification for Rubber Insulating Gloves
meta.disclaimer: Reference approximations for training and pre-job planning. A stamped arc flash study (IEEE 1584) and the employer's written switching procedures govern field work.

lee.name: Ralph Lee Method (NFPA 70E Annex D.2)
lee.formula: E = 5.12e5 x V x Ibf x (t / D^2)
lee.units: E cal/cm^2, V kV, Ibf kA, t s, D mm
lee.notes: Theoretical maximum open-air arc power. Conservative for systems above 600 V; may be excessively conservative below 600 V.

doughtyOpenAir.name: Doughty-Neal Method, Arc in Open Air (NFPA 70E Annex D.4)
doughtyOpenAir.units: E cal/cm^2, D in, t s, F kA

doughtyBox.name: Doughty-Neal Method, Arc in Cubic Box (NFPA 70E Annex D.4)
doughtyBox.units: E cal/cm^2, D in, t s, F kA

ppeCategories.label: Below Arc Flash Threshold
items: Non-melting, flammable natural-fiber clothing (untreated cotton, wool, silk)
Safety glasses or safety goggles (SR)
Hearing protection (ear canal inserts)
Heavy-duty leather gloves or rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors (as needed for shock)

ppeCategories.label: PPE Category 1
items: Arc-rated long-sleeve shirt and pants or arc-rated coverall (min. 4 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated face shield or arc flash suit hood (min. 4 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated jacket, parka, rainwear, or hard hat liner (AN)
Hard hat
Safety glasses or safety goggles (SR)
Hearing protection (ear canal inserts)
Heavy-duty leather gloves or rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
Leather footwear (AN)

ppeCategories.label: PPE Category 2
items: Arc-rated long-sleeve shirt and pants or arc-rated coverall (min. 8 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated flash suit hood, or arc-rated face shield and arc-rated balaclava (min. 8 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated jacket, parka, rainwear, or hard hat liner (AN)
Hard hat
Safety glasses or safety goggles (SR)
Hearing protection (ear canal inserts)
Heavy-duty leather gloves or rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
Leather footwear

ppeCategories.label: PPE Category 3
items: Arc-rated long-sleeve shirt and pants (AR) or coverall selected for total system rating of 25 cal/cm²
Arc-rated arc flash suit jacket and pants (AR)
Arc-rated arc flash suit hood (min. 25 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated gloves or rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
Arc-rated jacket, parka, rainwear, or hard hat liner (AN)
Hard hat
Safety glasses or safety goggles (SR)
Hearing protection (ear canal inserts)
Leather footwear

ppeCategories.label: PPE Category 4
items: Arc-rated long-sleeve shirt and pants (AR) or coverall selected for total system rating of 40 cal/cm²
Arc-rated arc flash suit jacket and pants (AR)
Arc-rated arc flash suit hood (min. 40 cal/cm²)
Arc-rated gloves or rubber insulating gloves with leather protectors
Arc-rated jacket, parka, rainwear, or hard hat liner (AN)
Hard hat
Safety glasses or safety goggles (SR)
Hearing protection (ear canal inserts)
Leather footwear

dangerLevel.label: DANGER - Exceeds PPE Category 4
items: No standard PPE category is adequate - energized work is prohibited by this playbook
De-energize the equipment and establish an electrically safe work condition (NFPA 70E 120.5)
Perform switching remotely (SCADA, remote racking device, or hot-stick from outside the arc flash boundary)
Engineering review of protective device settings (maintenance switch / reduced clearing time) required

insulatingGloves.source: ASTM D120 / OSHA 1910.137 Table I-4 (max use voltage, AC rms)
insulatingGloves.aboveMaxNote: Above 36 kV phase-to-phase: rubber insulating gloves are not rated for direct contact. Use live-line tools (hot sticks) rated for the system voltage and maintain minimum approach distance.

switching.source: OSHA 1910.269(d), (m), (n) and NFPA 70E 120.5 - Establishing an Electrically Safe Work Condition

requires.message: Switching device operated before a switching order / clearance authorization was obtained from the system operator.
requires.remedy: Obtain and read back the switching order before operating any device.

requires.message: Air-break disconnect switch opened under full load before the circuit breaker was opened. Disconnects are not load-break rated - opening under load draws a sustained arc across the blades.
requires.remedy: Open the circuit breaker first to interrupt load current, then open the disconnect to create a visible break.

requires.message: Switching device operated before a switching order / clearance authorization was obtained from the system operator.
requires.remedy: Obtain and read back the switching order before operating any device.

rack_out_breaker.label: Rack out breaker to disconnected position

requires.message: Breaker racked out while closed. Racking a closed breaker separates the primary disconnects under load.
requires.remedy: Open and verify the breaker is open (mechanical indicator) before racking. Use a remote racking device where available.

requires.message: Visual verification performed but no disconnecting device has been opened - there is no visible break to verify.
requires.remedy: Open the disconnect switch (or rack out the breaker) before visual verification.

requires.message: Lockout/tagout applied while the isolating device is still closed. The lock does not establish isolation.
requires.remedy: Open all disconnecting means before applying locks and tags.

requires.message: Lockout/tagout applied while the circuit breaker is still closed.
requires.remedy: Open the circuit breaker and lock/tag its control circuit.

requires.message: Locks applied without first visually verifying that all blades are fully open.
requires.remedy: Insert a 'Visually verify open points' step before applying locks.

requires.message: Testing for absence of voltage on a circuit that has not been isolated. The worker is performing energized work without an energized work permit.
requires.remedy: Open and verify the isolation point before testing.

requires.message: Absence-of-voltage test performed before lockout/tagout was applied - the circuit could be re-energized after the test.
requires.remedy: Apply lockout/tagout, then test for absence of voltage.

requires.message: Protective grounds installed before testing for absence of voltage. If the line is energized, applying grounds creates a bolted three-phase fault at the worker's hands.
requires.remedy: Test for absence of voltage with a rated detector (live-dead-live) immediately before installing grounds.

requires.message: Grounds installed on a circuit whose disconnecting device is still closed.
requires.remedy: Open, verify, and lock out the isolating device before grounding.

requires.message: Grounds installed before isolation devices were locked and tagged.
requires.remedy: Lock and tag all isolation points before grounding.

requires.message: Work started on a de-energized line without protective grounds installed. Lines must be treated as energized until grounded.
requires.remedy: Install temporary protective grounds at the work location before issuing the clearance.

requires.message: Work started without testing for absence of voltage.
requires.remedy: Test for absence of voltage before work begins.

requires.message: Work started without lockout/tagout on all sources.
requires.remedy: Apply locks and tags to all isolation points before work begins.

requires.message: Work marked complete but no work step was active.
requires.remedy: Confirm the step order of the work and completion steps.

requires.message: Protective grounds removed while work is still in progress.
requires.remedy: Confirm all crew members are clear and the work is complete before removing grounds.

requires.message: Locks and tags removed while protective grounds are still installed - a re-energization path into the grounds is now possible.
requires.remedy: Remove all protective grounds before removing locks and tags.

requires.message: Lockout/tagout removed while work is still in progress.
requires.remedy: Complete work and account for all employees before removing locks.

requires.message: Disconnect closed with protective grounds still installed - energizing into grounds produces a bolted fault.
requires.remedy: Remove all protective grounds before any closing operation.

requires.message: Locked/tagged disconnect operated before lockout/tagout devices were removed.
requires.remedy: Remove locks and tags (by the employee who applied them) before operating the device.

requires.message: Air-break disconnect closed while the circuit breaker is closed - the disconnect makes the load/fault current.
requires.remedy: Close the disconnect with the breaker open, then close the breaker to pick up load.

requires.message: Circuit breaker closed with protective grounds still installed - energizing into grounds produces a bolted fault.
requires.remedy: Remove all protective grounds before re-energizing.

requires.message: Circuit breaker closed while lockout/tagout devices are still applied.
requires.remedy: Remove locks and tags before re-energizing.

requires.message: Breaker closed while the disconnect is still open - the circuit remains de-energized.
requires.remedy: Close the disconnect first, then close the breaker.

requires.message: Clearance released while protective grounds are still installed.
requires.remedy: Remove all grounds before releasing the clearance.

requires.message: Clearance released while lockout/tagout devices are still applied.
requires.remedy: Remove locks and tags before releasing the clearance.

endStateHazards.message: Procedure restores the circuit but ends with protective grounds still installed.
endStateHazards.remedy: Add a 'Remove temporary protective grounds' step before restoration.

endStateHazards.message: Procedure restores the circuit without a 'work complete / crew clear' step.
endStateHazards.remedy: Add a 'Work complete - crew clear & accounted' step before removing grounds.

endStateHazards.message: Procedure never obtains a switching order / clearance authorization.
endStateHazards.remedy: Add 'Obtain switching order / clearance authorization' as the first step.
